role_title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React, Node.js, Cloud)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to build next-generation cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable frontend components using React and TypeScript.
- Develop scalable backend microservices using Node.js, Express.js, and Python (FastAPI).
- Design relational database models in PostgreSQL and caching strategies using Redis.
- Deploy applications on AWS cloud using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
- Collaborate with product management, UI/UX designers, and QA teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Required Qualifications & Skills:
- 4+ years of professional full stack software development experience.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and HTML5/CSS3.
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL and Redis.
- Solid experience with Docker, AWS (S3, EC2), and CI/CD tools.
- Familiarity with Next.js, GraphQL, and microservices architecture is a major plus.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

Join our AI research team to build cutting-edge Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) applications.

Requirements:
- Strong expertise in Python, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, and SQL.
- Experience in NLP, Transformers, LLMs (LangChain, HuggingFace), and model deployment.
- Experience with FastAPI, Docker, MLOps (MLflow/SageMaker), and cloud services (AWS or GCP).
- Familiarity with Vector Databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB) and RAG architecture.
- MS or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or related quantitative field.

Looking for a seasoned DevOps Cloud Engineer to manage enterprise AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes orchestration, and Terraform automated provisioning.

Requirements:
- Deep experience with AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, VPC), Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
- Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Configuration Management (Ansible).
- Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
- Knowledge of monitoring stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack.
- Proficiency in Linux system administration and Python/Bash scripting.
